title: ReplaceDashboardContentsRequest
description: Body of PUT /api/dashboards/:id/contents (HEL-363) — atomically replaces ALL of an existing dashboard's panels with the supplied set. Reuses the ProposalPanel wire shape verbatim (no separate DTO, no pre-existing panel id needed — every panel gets a freshly minted id). The target dashboard's id comes from the URL path, not the body.
